beats.text: Six hard truths that sting at first — then quietly set you free.
One. No one is coming to save you. That's not despair. That's the beginning of your power.
Two. Most people won't clap for you. Build the life anyway. Applause was never the point.
Three. Discipline will carry you to places motivation never even finds the door to.
Four. You slowly become the five people you spend the most time with. Choose carefully.
Five. Comfort is pleasant, and it's exactly where most dreams quietly go to sleep.
Six. Time is passing whether you use it or not. The only choice is whether it counts.
The truth is heavy — but it's lighter than the lies you've been carrying instead.
